name: Modern Dragon 25
author: JasonMep
description: Orange button that responds while pressed down with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: While pressed, box-shadow becomes 0px 2px 0px #d35400, top becomes 2px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Modern Dragon 25</title>
<style>
/* Modern Dragon 25 by JasonMep — https://uiverse.io/JasonMep/modern-dragon-25 */
.button {
 color: #ecf0f1;
 font-size: 17px;
 background-color: #e67e22;
 border: 1px solid #f39c12;
 border-radius: 5px;
 padding: 10px;
 box-shadow: 0px 6px 0px #d35400;
 transition: all .1s;
}

.button:active {
 box-shadow: 0px 2px 0px #d35400;
 position: relative;
 top: 2px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Click Here</button>

</body>
</html>
